pairs: tu cognovisti sessionem meam et resurrectionem meam.
You have known my sitting down and my rising up again.
You have understood my thoughts from afar.
And you have foreseen all my ways.
quia non est sermo in lingua mea.
For there is no word in my tongue.
the newest and the very old.
et posuisti super me manum tuam.
and you have placed your hand over me.
Mirabilis facta est scientia tua ex me;
Your knowledge has become a wonder to me.
and I am not able to prevail against it.
Where will I go from your Spirit?
et quo a facie tua fugiam?
And where will I flee from your face?
If I assume my feathers in early morning,
and dwell in the utmost parts of the sea,
etenim illuc manus tua deducet me,
even there, your hand will lead me forth,
and your right hand will hold me.
et nox illuminatio mea in deliciis meis.
and the night will be my illumination, to my delight.
Quia tenebræ non obscurabuntur a te,
But darkness will not be impenetrable to you,
and night will illuminate like the day:
for just as its darkness is,
For you have possessed my temperament.
suscepisti me de utero matris meæ.
You have supported me from the womb of my mother.
for you have been magnified terribly.
as my soul knows exceedingly well.
Non est occultatum os meum a te,
My bone, which you have made in secret,
has not been hidden from you,
et substantia mea in inferioribus terræ.
and my substance is in accord with the lower parts of the earth.
et in libro tuo omnes scribentur.
and all this shall be written in your book.
and no one shall be in them.
Mihi autem nimis honorificati sunt amici tui,
But to me, O God, your friends have been greatly honored.
Deus; nimis confortatus est principatus eorum.
Their first ruler has been exceedingly strengthened.
and they will be more numerous than the sand.
and I am still with you.
if only you would cut down sinners.
They will accept your cities in vain.
Have I not hated those who hated you,
oderam, et super inimicos tuos tabescebam?
Lord, and wasted away because of your enemies?
I have hated them with a perfect hatred,
and they have become enemies to me.
Et vide si via iniquitatis in me est,
And see if there might be in me the way of iniquity,
et deduc me in via æterna.
and lead me in the way of eternity.
